body:
The wrapping feels like an old friend, its rough surface tugging gently against my skin as I wrap my arms around it. A sense of deep connection washes over me—it’s not just physical warmth but also a feeling of safety and security. I lean closer, breathing in the earthy scent, letting out a soft sigh.

I close my eyes for a moment, remembering stories passed down through generations about this same tree—its gnarled branches casting dappled shadows on summer nights and its fruits filling baskets year after year. It holds memories, both good and bad.
